newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Sports sells O'Brien unit.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Sports sells O'Brien unit.

text.p: Meridian Sports Inc said Monday that it has sold its O'Brien watersports division to Earth and Ocean Sports Inc for what the company termed "a small premium" to book value.
Meridian said it expects to report a "small" profit on the sale after expenses associated with the transaction and before extraordinary charges related to the early extinguishment of debt.
The company said the proceeds will be used to pay down debt.
Meridian said that in 1996 the company had operating income of about $500,000 and an average net book value of about $12.5 million.
Meridian makes specialized ski boats and scuba equipment.
